question: Who has been appointed as UNICEF India's first ever Youth Ambassador in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hima Das**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hima Das**, the Indian sprinter and gold medalist at the 2018 Asian Games, was appointed as **UNICEF India's first-ever Youth Ambassador** in **2018**.
 
• Her appointment was in recognition of her achievements in sports and her ability to inspire youth, especially girls, to break barriers and pursue their dreams.
 
• As UNICEF's Youth Ambassador, Hima Das aimed to advocate for children's rights, including education, health, and gender equality.
 
• Hima Das is a celebrated Indian sprinter who gained international fame for winning a gold medal at the **2018 IAAF World U-20 Championships** in **Finland**,
 
 
• where she became the first Indian woman to win a global track event. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sakshi Malik:
 
 
• Sakshi Malik is an Indian wrestler who gained national and international recognition for winning a bronze medal at the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro.
 
• She became the first Indian female wrestler to win an Olympic medal, which was a historic achievement for India.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Shri (India’s fourth-highest civilian award) for her contributions to sports in 2017.
 
 
 
• Nahid Aafreen:
 
 
• Nahid Aafreen is an Indian singer and performer, best known for her participation in the popular Indian singing reality show Indian Idol (Season 9).
 
• Although Nahid Aafreen has been recognized for her musical talent and contributions to the arts, she was not appointed as UNICEF India’s Youth Ambassador in 2018. However, she has used her platform to promote various causes related to youth empowerment and humanitarian work, but she has not been specifically associated with UNICEF in the same way as Hima Das.
 
• Nahid, being a young artist, is an inspiration to many aspiring singers, especially girls from smaller towns, to pursue their passions and break cultural stereotypes.
 
 
 
• Mary Kom:
 
 
• Mary Kom, also known as Magnificent Mary, is one of India’s most celebrated boxers.
 
• She is a six-time world champion and an Olympic bronze medalist (2012 London Olympics).
 
• Mary Kom has been an ambassador for various social causes, particularly women’s empowerment and youth development.
 
• She has also been involved in promoting sports for young girls and encouraging them to pursue their dreams, similar to the work Hima Das has done as a youth ambassador.
